The "Biographical Dictionary of Actors" contains an inconclusive discussion of the claim in Davies' "Dramatic Miscellanies" (1784) that Verbruggen was identical to the actor referred to in 1680s and 90s cast lists as "Mr. Alexander", supposedly an alias based on the part of Alexander the Great in John Dryden's Rival Queens.
